# std/addr

> Address of a place: &x

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/addr.pkg) · translated by [bintables/addr](../bintables/addr.md)

Gives a pointer to a variable, a field or a slice element.

```
fn bump(counter: ptr int)
  *counter = *counter + 1
end

let n = 0
bump(&n)
print n     // 1
```

A pointer to a local variable is only valid while its function is
running.

## Syntax

Kind: `prefix`, precedence 80, left-associative

```
& {x: place} -> ptr {x}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` |  | — |

Produces: `ptr {x}`
